name: Cheech & Chong - 1g Cart - Dream Cake (I)
description:
Sweet, creamy, and dessert-smooth. The Cheech & Chong Dream Cake cartridge holds 1 gram of premium oil — a distillate base blended with terpenes — in a universal-fit 510-thread cart that screws right onto any standard battery. Simple, reliable, and made to last.

Dream Cake serves up a rich, bakery-style profile: sweet vanilla cake and creamy frosting notes up front, rounded out by a smooth, subtly earthy finish. Blended with an indica terpene profile for a relaxed, mellow feel — indulgent and easygoing, made for winding down at the end of the day.

Why you'll love it:

1G total oil — premium distillate blended with terpenes for full flavor
Universal 510-thread fit — works with any standard 510 battery
Signature Dream Cake flavor — sweet vanilla cake with creamy frosting notes
Indica terpene blend — relaxing and mellow, ideal for evenings
Cheech & Chong — a name that's been in the game since day one

Rich flavor and dependable quality in a classic, easy-to-use cartridge. Just attach your battery and enjoy — Cheech & Chong Dream Cake is ready when you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
